verdict.rationale: Data region or residency selection is a fair question for a cloud AI service like ChatGPT, but the evidence pack never documents choosing a storage region. Related items cover only general data controls (chatgpt-docs-89) and local Work that keeps files on your computer (chatgpt-docs-33). Those are adjacent features, not region or residency choice, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
